name: Boss Gladys Jepkosgei
biography: Shollei, Gladys Jepkosgei-Boss is a two-term serving County Woman Representative for Uasin Gishu County. She was first elected in 2017 and reelected in 2022. She was the Chairperson of the Delegated Legislation Committee from 2017 to 2019 and a member of the Justice & Legal Affairs Committee from 2017 to 2019, the Liaison Committee from 2019 to 2022 and the Procedure & House rules Committee from 2019 to 2022.
positions: A member of the 13th Parliament from September 8, 2022 to Present
committees: The Chair of the LIAISON committee.
A member of the APPOINTMENTS committee.
A member of the JUSTICE AND LEGAL AFFAIRS committee.
A member of the PROCEDURE AND HOUSE RULES committee.
